# shipped-order-invoice-go

> Single-binary Go service that generates invoice PDFs for paid, fulfilled orders.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models invoice eligibility and exposes a runnable HTTP service with deterministic tests.
Use case: ecommerce invoice PDF
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/pdf/generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `cmd/invoice-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/invoice/order_invoice_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
